items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: I asked when Jimmy Ferrest joined the band, and you said about four years ago. [INTERVIEWEE] Mm hmm.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah? I don't know whether we're going to -- I guess we'll probably -- on our way back -- maybe coming back from the coast -- the west coast -- we'll probably stop in there.

Well, let's just speak of the fact -- let's talk about -- we were really speaking about how around the present band -- what changes there were that brought about this present band. I asked when Jimmy Ferrest joined the band, and you said about four years ago.
